suggestions.title: Metropolis
suggestions.description: In a futuristic city sharply divided between the rich and the poor, the son of the city's mastermind meets a prophet who predicts the coming of a savior to mediate their differences. Fritz Lang's monumental German expressionist silent masterpiece is one of the most influential and visually stunning films ever made — the blueprint for virtually all dystopian sci-fi that followed, from Blade Runner to The Matrix.

suggestions.title: The Princess Bride
suggestions.description: A young man sets out to rescue his true love from an evil prince in this fairy tale adventure. Rob Reiner's endlessly quotable, genre-sending fairy tale is pure cinematic joy — swordsmanship, true love, giants, and 'inconceivable' wordplay. A warm, funny adventure that's as beloved by adults as it is by the kids who grew up on it.

suggestions.title: Gone Girl
suggestions.description: A husband becomes the prime suspect in his wife's disappearance as media frenzy exposes their troubled marriage. David Fincher's razor-sharp psychological thriller, based on Gillian Flynn's bestselling novel, is a searing dissection of modern marriage and media manipulation with one of the most jaw-dropping twists in recent cinema. Rosamund Pike is unforgettable.
